name: Mini Pine Cone
description:
Natural mini pine cones for vivarium and terrarium hardscape. Add woodland texture and forest-floor realism to planted setups, mossariums, and bioactive enclosures. The layered scales create visual interest and can provide micro-hiding spots for cleanup-crew invertebrates and feeder insects.

Product Features:
• Natural dried mini pine cones
• Ideal accent for forest-floor and woodland-themed layouts
• Lightweight and easy to place among moss, leaf litter, and substrate
• Suitable for vivariums, terrariums, paludariums, and fairy gardens
• Each cone is unique in shape, tone, and scale pattern

Size:
Approx. 2–4 cm (mini)

Ideal For:
Naturalistic forest floors, bioactive enrichment, miniature woodland scenes, and decorative hardscape accents.

Note: Natural product — size and color may vary slightly. Spot-clean as needed; replace if mould develops in high-humidity setups.
